decisions.reason: Because it is distant from the firm's established offer and not central to the announced integrated maritime solutions, with only a brief website mention after two years, escalation pressures are weak and resources are better reallocated.
As a crew recruitment service that builds on the firm's core maritime offer, its centrality and two-year public visibility sustain commitment despite the absence of quantified results.
It has a dedicated page and reports a growing partner network shortly after launch, so results do not disappoint and the firm will not withdraw a central, recently invested educational programme.
Close to the established offer and reporting successful FuelEU compliance submissions, it shows clear early results that justify continued commitment.

Recently launched and central to the announced digitalisation and environmental direction, with visible integration into PAL software, any absence of results is temporary and escalation strongly favours keeping it.

As a recently launched cost simulation tool aligned with environmental compliance and integrated into existing software, it is central and publicly committed, so the firm will treat early quiet as temporary and keep it.
